about: Gregory S. Weiss is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026. He works at Taft Stettinius & Hollister LLP, located in West Palm Beach, Florida, and provides legal services for issues involving Business Litigation to the surrounding community.
Gregory Weiss completed legal studies at University of Florida Levin College of Law and graduated with the class of 1998. Gregory Weiss passed the bar in 1999.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
